responsibility: Declares the table-driven data structures, enums, and macros used by the C-family format-checking engine. It describes recognized length modifiers, standards levels, conversion-specifier metadata, and target attribute override records that c-format.cc uses to parse format strings and map specifiers to GCC tree types and warning rules.
same_name_distinction: Data-definition header for the format checker: it defines the enums, descriptor structs, and table macros that encode format-specifier metadata, whereas c-format.cc consumes those definitions to execute actual -Wformat parsing, checking, and diagnostics.
